_comment: Asset manifest for the Godot slice (#631). Every visible object in the vertical slice is generated from Godot primitives in scenes/lakkahaltia/ward.gd; no third-party file is committed. This manifest records that decision and the packs reviewed for a later art pass, so the next contributor starts from licence facts rather than assumptions.

reviewed_for_later_use.licence: CC0 for most packs; verify per pack
CC0 for most packs; verify per pack

reviewed_for_later_use.status: optional; do not commit purchased files unless the licence permits public redistribution

rules: No asset enters this repository without a per-pack licence check, an attribution line if required, and a public-repo redistribution check.
Placeholder art must be either generated (as here) or explicitly CC0; 'found online' is not a licence.
